scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:backend && npm run test:unit:frontend
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && docker compose run --rm flyway
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v db && npm run db:up && npm run db:seed
scripts.app:dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n back,front -c blue,green "dotnet watch --project backend/Chiga.Api" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
